reviews.text: The puppy got a very clean wash at the dog washing shop. 🌹 …

Big, big. Well-stocked, with competent and fast staff.
It also has a grooming area for four-legged friends, clean and with loving staff.
Thank you Gaetano for choosing Acquario Pet Story.

The shop is well stocked, the staff are very kind and polite, but the grooming is to be avoided like the black plague! I brought my 7-month-old dog for his first bath, I stopped by to make an appointment and I already had my first argument... not even a month ago I ASKED FOR INFORMATION about the price and if there was availability, the response was: there is no space but leave me the number. (There was no reservation!!!!) He called me in the afternoon, telling me that a space had become available, but because it was raining I refused since I was on foot, so if I had washed the dog that day it would have been useless! However, he asked me..."But what if you book like last time and then don't come, in a very ironic tone!?!" Very politely I reminded him that I had NEVER booked, it was he (kindly and thanking him too) who had called, but it was raining. Anyway... I brought my puppy and reminded him that it was his first bath and that he was VERY scared!!! He PULLS him up by the harness, my scared puppy pees. The girl next to him let out a scream that would have made the greatest Oxford professors pale, exclaiming: "waaa and what the hell, he PEED! Pure delicacy and elegance!!!!. Now, from a person who has worked with animals for a long time you would expect greater competence and empathy, but NO!!! In a rude way, he puts the dog on the bed and instead of reassuring him, with his rude manners he agitates him even more. Out of so much fear, unfortunately he bites him (he has all his vaccinations) and is literally thrown off the bed. And while I was trying to understand how my dog ​​was, if he had hurt himself after the fall, I even heard him scream: "Take this dog and go, who's going to wash him?"!!! Who will wash him for me???? A capable person!!!! I can understand that it's not nice to receive a bite, but you don't react like that. He's a 7-month-old Pinscher, not a Doberman, a Pitbull. Put up a nice sign outside that says: "Only for dogs that seem like puppets, those who let themselves do everything, because we don't know how to handle others!!! They may even "be good", but their ways, their attitudes, both towards me but especially towards my puppy, disconcerted me. And they may even say that the dog has "behavioral problems" to justify themselves... but those who know how to work know that there can be "occupational hazards," and those who are COMPETENT also know how to handle certain situations. I don't think mine was the first dog in recent years to react like this. Luckily, he's fine!

Once you try them, you'll never let them go. I have a dog who's crazy, unmanageable, and they always do an exceptional job with professionalism and patience. They also give you advice on many things that less experienced people wouldn't think of. And they have a well-stocked shop with everything for everyone.

Thank you so much for your feedback Elvira.

I'm giving it 1 star because I can't give it 0. Unfortunately, the animals sold are malnourished. The other day I saw a poor hamster who could barely walk, with his fur all ruffled and he was looking for help near the glass, a dead fish and they wouldn't even remove it from the aquarium and no one in there helps them. There are a lot of staff, but the staff in question don't care about the animals' health and I won't go back because I was heartbroken watching those horrible scenes. If I could, I would have rescued them myself, but unfortunately there are so many sick and malnourished animals that I've lost count. I hope someone takes action and does something, because we can't continue like this. HELP THOSE POOR LITTLE BEASTS, PLEASE. 😭😭😭
Thanks Antonio for your review, we look forward to seeing you soon at our stores.

The shop is stocked with everything you need to feed your four-legged friends, and more. It also has accessories like bird cages, aquariums, collars, leashes, etc. The staff is friendly and always ready to help. They also offer a grooming service, which, truth be told, has been excellent for the past three years. Of course, the grooming staff is also friendly, helpful, and available to accommodate any requests, such as changes to reservations, etc.
Thanks Clemente for your review
Well stocked, the owner and staff are extremely competent and, above all, professional.

I brought my bulldog for the second time, the groomer was rude, asking me how long it had been since I'd taken him for a bath because he was crying and the hair dryer bothered him. I told him that my vet and the breeder recommended having him bathed three times a year because they tend to stink if they're bathed too often and their immune system weakens (I agree with them, though). How would he respond to me about having him bathed by his vet or at home because he doesn't want to be held responsible for a supposed heart attack? Unfortunately, I wasn't able to answer because he caught me off guard. I wasn't expecting something like that. I didn't know the groomer had a medical degree, and he's also presumptuous and wants to know more than a vet. Anyway, don't worry, I'll NEVER take him again; I'll give him bad publicity.
I may think it's August, and he's tired, but that doesn't justify it. It's not a form of speech. Everyone's head burns. Don't do this job if you can't handle stress.
Thank you so much for your review Francesca
